metaDescription: Kevin walks through whokilledthescientists.com, his tracker of dead or missing US scientists tied to UAP, nuclear, and advanced propulsion research.
summary: Kevin presents whokilledthescientists.com, a free site he built to track a dozen or more scientists who died or went missing, many tied to NASA JPL, Los Alamos, and advanced propulsion or weapons work. He says he does not know whether a conspiracy exists and that skeptics may be right. The site features profiles, a timeline, a mind map, and twice-daily updates. Kevin highlights candidates he identified with Claude, including Charles McMillan, Philip Leonard, and William Deninger, and notes Los Alamos road crashes. He also cites Amy Eskridge's anti-gravity claims and says he plans to check possible Epstein-file links.

keyMoments.label: Why The Dead Scientists Story Matters
